backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining types (ToolListing, RentalRequest, UserProfile, CommunityMapProfile with coordinates and address) and CRUD operations for a peer-to-peer tool rental marketplace with authorization, profiles, listings, rentals, and chat functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: required address field in SetCoordinatesDialog, zoom controls in GlobeMap, and visible pin markers for user locations on the globe.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Summaries of frontend files including pages (ListingFormPage, RentalDetailPage, MyRentalsPage, etc.), components (RentalStatusActions, CameraCapturePanel, PhotoReferencesField), hooks (useQueries with address parameter), and utilities (fileToDataUrl, timeOnApp).
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors including background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, and sidebar variants.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tag and root div mounting the app from main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component configuring TanStack Router with routes for landing, browse, listings, rentals, messaging, profile, and community map pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider and AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button component using Internet Identity authentication with loading states, error handling for duplicate authentication, and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Authentication guard component that displays a login prompt card when user is not authenticated, otherwise renders children.
frontend/src/components/community/Commun: Community map panel component rendering a 3D globe with WebGL support detection, zoom in/out controls, member selection, and a profile card overlay for selected members.
frontend/src/components/community/GlobeM: Renders an interactive 3D globe using Three.js/React Three Fiber with location pins for community members. Includes camera-aware scaling, hover/selection states, and animated halos for selected pins.
frontend/src/components/community/SetCoo: Dialog component for users to input their street address, city, and postal code to be geocoded and displayed on the community map. Validates required fields and updates user profile with address.
frontend/src/components/landing/Floating: Canvas-based animation layer that renders floating geometric objects (orbs, rings, faceted shapes, torus) with parallax motion, wobble, and pulse effects. Respects reduced motion preferences and device pixel ratio.
frontend/src/components/landing/Interact: Wrapper component that applies 3D tilt effect to children based on mouse position, with dynamic shadows and highlight gradients. Disables on touch devices and respects reduced motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/landing/LandingI: Simple wrapper component for landing page images that enforces accessibility (alt text) and provides consistent styling with lazy loading by default.
Landing page section showcasing the tool library concept with hero illustration, descriptive text, and statistics cards (savings and support). Uses two-column responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/components/landing/Toolshed: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Simple footer component displaying copyright notice and attribution to caffeine.ai with a heart icon.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Main navigation header with logo, navigation links (Browse, My Tools, Rentals, Requests, Messages, Community Map), authentication state, and mobile sheet menu. Shows different nav items based on auth status.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root layout component that wraps pages with AppHeader, main content area, and AppFooter in a flex column layout.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageHeade: Reusable page header component displaying a title, optional subtitle, and optional action buttons in a flex layout.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageShell: A simple layout wrapper component that applies container styling and padding to its children.
frontend/src/components/listings/BrowseF: A comprehensive filter bar component for browsing tool listings with search, category selection, price range, availability toggle, and sorting options.
frontend/src/components/listings/CameraC: A camera interface component that allows users to capture photos using device camera, with support for camera switching, error handling, and fallback to URL input.
frontend/src/components/listings/Listing: Displays a responsive grid of tool listing cards with images, titles, descriptions, location, price, and availability status, linking to individual listing pages.
frontend/src/components/listings/OwnerAc: A dropdown menu component for listing owners to edit their listing or toggle its availability status.
frontend/src/components/listings/PhotoRe: A form field component for managing listing photos, supporting both URL input and camera capture with preview and removal capabilities.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Active: Displays the active rental conversation with tool details, user information, rental dates, status badge, and embedded chat panel.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: A scrollable list of rental conversations showing tool titles, other party names, and rental status with selection highlighting.
frontend/src/components/navigation/AppNa: A styled navigation link component wrapping TanStack Router's Link with active/inactive state styling and hover effects.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: A dropdown menu component displaying user profile information with avatar, navigation to profile page, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: A modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without profiles to create one, collecting display name, contact info, location, and address.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalCh: A chat interface component for rental conversations, displaying messages with sender alignment and supporting real-time message sending with Enter key support.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalRe: A form component for submitting tool rental requests with start/end date selection and validation, converting dates to bigint timestamps for IC backend.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalSt: Provides action buttons for rental status updates (approve/decline/cancel/complete) with confirmation dialogs, conditionally rendered based on user role and current status.
frontend/src/components/states/EmptyStat: A reusable card component for displaying empty states with an icon, title, description, and optional action button.
frontend/src/components/states/ErrorStat: A reusable card component for displaying error states with a destructive-styled alert icon, title, description, and optional action button.
frontend/src/components/states/LoadingSt: A centered loading spinner component with optional message text for displaying loading states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance, handling authentication state changes and invalidating dependent queries when the actor updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity storage, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapTransform.ts: Custom hook for managing interactive map transformations including zoom, pan, drag, and multi-touch pinch gestures with configurable bounds and thresholds.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapZoom.ts: Simplified hook for map zoom functionality with wheel event handling and configurable zoom levels, without pan or drag support.
frontend/src/hooks/useParallaxMotion.ts: Hook that tracks mouse position and scroll offset to provide parallax motion values, respecting user's reduced motion preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Hook that detects and monitors the user's prefers-reduced-motion media query setting for accessibility.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralized React Query hooks for all backend data operations including user profiles, tool listings, rental requests, and chat messages with mutations and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useWebGLSupport.ts: Hook that detects WebGL support in the browser and returns support status, checking state, and error information.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, 3D transforms, texture backgrounds, and reduced motion accessibility overrides.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseListingsPage.ts: Page component for browsing tool listings with search, filtering by category/price/availability, sorting options, and profile setup dialog integration.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityMapPage.tsx: Displays an interactive community map showing ToolShare members with addresses, includes a directory list, and prompts authenticated users without addresses to add their location via a dialog.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page with hero section, floating 3D objects background, "How It Works" steps, and CTAs to browse tools or sign up; adapts buttons based on authentication state.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed view of a single tool listing with photos, pricing, condition, and location; displays rental request form for non-owners or owner action buttons for the listing owner.
frontend/src/pages/ListingFormPage.tsx: Form page for creating or editing tool listings with fields for title, category, description, condition, pricing, location, availability, and photo references; supports both create and edit modes.
frontend/src/pages/MessagingPage.tsx: Authenticated messaging interface displaying a list of rental-based conversations and an active chat panel for communicating with other users about rentals.
frontend/src/pages/MyRentalsPage.tsx: Displays authenticated user's rental requests and bookings as cards with status badges and action buttons; shows empty state if no rentals exist.
frontend/src/pages/MyToolsPage.tsx: Displays the authenticated user's tool listings with alerts for pending rental requests and active rentals, plus an 'Add Tool' button. Shows loading, empty, or grid states for owned tools.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page with view/edit modes for display name, contact info, location, address, and profile picture. Supports URL parameter '?edit=1' to trigger edit mode on load.
frontend/src/pages/RentalDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a specific rental including tool details, rental dates, cost calculation, status badge, and chat panel. Includes status action buttons for owners and renters.
frontend/src/pages/RequestsPage.tsx: Shows incoming rental requests for tools owned by the authenticated user. Each request card displays tool info, dates, status badge, and action buttons.
frontend/src/utils/fileToDataUrl.ts: Converts a File object to a base64-encoded data URL string using FileReader API wrapped in a Promise.
frontend/src/utils/geoProjection.ts: Provides equirectangular projection utilities to convert geographic coordinates (lat/lon) to screen position percentages, with validation and parsing helpers.
frontend/src/utils/globeProjection.ts: Converts latitude/longitude coordinates to 3D vector positions on a sphere surface using spherical-to-Cartesian transformation for Three.js rendering.
frontend/src/utils/rentals/rentalDateFor: Formats bigint nanosecond timestamps to human-readable date strings and calculates rental duration in days.
frontend/src/utils/rentals/rentalStatusP: Maps RentalStatus enum values to color classes and display labels for consistent UI presentation of rental states.
frontend/src/utils/timeOnApp.ts: Formats bigint nanosecond timestamps into relative time strings (e.g., '2 months') and absolute join dates for user profiles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, and custom keyframe animations for UI components.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for a community mapping application documenting three existing features: required address field, zoom controls, and location pin markers on an interactive globe.
